Collecting after harvestB. Collected after harvestC. Collect after harvestD. To collect after harvestWrite A, B, C, or D - {#3} Question 16.A. This meant that crop waste had become a type of fossil fuel.B. The officers concluded that renewable energy produced more soot.C. This widened the discussion from crop-waste burning to another source of warming emissions.D. The area therefore no longer needed to think about greenhouse gases.C. The change addressed one clear source of warming pollution, although it did not solve every climate problem.D. Black carbon had become a useful source of renewable energy for farms.Write A, B, C, or D - {#5}
